title: 第18章 出北丰国第19章 方有为失踪
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
马车又开始晃悠起来了。
马车上，方有为紧闭着眼睛，靠在车箱上。
林鹤清也不好和齐爷爷说话，免得打扰他，所以就掀开窗帘看外面的风景。
一转眼，五天过去了。
方有为也和林鹤清熟悉了起来，三人也时常聊天，当然大部分是林鹤清和方有为在聊天，齐爷爷不加入他们的话题。
方有为不愧是是经常走南闯北的商户，聊起什么来都是头头是道，尤其是还有些做生意的小技巧什么的，他也大大方方的说出来。
据方有为说，他是贤阳城的一个商户，来这里也是因为现在需要接手家中事务，需要去何处分店考察，他是第一次来到良泉镇的。
还问林鹤清是哪里人，现在要去哪里？
两个人是闲聊天，但是林鹤清心里有点提起来了。
其实在古代问这个也没有别的意思，只是相互了解的一个步骤罢了。
但是林鹤清的观念里面，古代只要知道你的姓名地址，基本上就能找到人，贸然透露自己的信息，也容易给别人伤害自己的机会。
再说了，贤阳城那么大，方有为也没说自己家住哪里，是不是真的叫方有为还有待考证。
林鹤清决定就说一些大家都知道的事实，什么都不说可能大家也挺尴尬的。
“我就是良泉镇的人啊，我就在这里出生的，从小到大都在良泉镇，这是我第一次出远门。
有为兄，我真羡慕你，可以天南海北的到处跑，见识又那么丰富。”
“哈哈哈哈，这有什么，等你长大了，你也会有自己的事业，到时候这天高海阔的，想去哪就去哪。”
其实方有为应该就是习惯性的问问，因为他一直都是领导者的地位，习惯了解大家的背景身份，方便他更好的与人相处。
而他看见林鹤清大大咧咧的，一个第一次出远门的孩子，没必要防备那么多，和林鹤清相处也就自然点了。
具体就表现在，方有为不再每天没事找事的和林鹤清聊天，而是自己兴致来了，才睁开眼睛，搭搭话。
本来林鹤清的马车上只有两套被褥，一人一套，林鹤清还在抽条，晚上睡觉在马车上也不觉得挤。

方有为到林鹤清马车上的时候，被子就不够用了，林鹤清和齐爷爷共一床被子。
过了两天，路过一个镇的时候，镖局进去了里面，一般镖局除非要补充物资，是不会进城镇的。
这次也是这样，多了这么多人，马车得置办，还要买些干粮被褥，这天气越来越冷，如果没有被子的话，路上怕是不好过。
好在被抢的商队说自己还有些积蓄藏着，还可以自己置办东西。
奇怪的是，明明方有为还有银票买蚕丝被，却没有自己再买一辆马车。
而是选择给林鹤清还有齐大夫都买了一床蚕丝被，作为冒昧打扰的赔礼，要知道，这被子可不是什么便宜的东西。
路过两国边境的时候，镖队停了下来，林鹤清没有下车，而且在车上往外面看，到处都有声音传来。
出去的地方是一个五辆马车能并排行走的一个超级大的城门，边上还有官兵手持红缨枪在站岗。
林鹤清的车队被夹在中间，前后左右都堵的死死的，什么都看不见，只能听见一些声音传来。
content_en:
The carriage began to rock again.
On the carriage, Fang Youwei closed his eyes tightly and leaned against the carriage.
Lin Heqing couldn't talk to Grandpa Qi, so as not to disturb him, so he opened the curtains and looked at the scenery outside.
In a blink of an eye, five days passed.
Fang Youwei also became familiar with Lin Heqing, and the three of them often chatted. Of course, Lin Heqing and Fang Youwei were mostly chatting, and Grandpa Qi did not join in their conversations.
Fang Youwei is indeed a businessman who often travels all over the country. He talks about everything in a clear and logical manner, especially some business tips and so on. He also talks about it openly.
According to Fang Youwei, he is a merchant in Xianyang City. He came here because he needs to take over the affairs at home and needs to check out which branches. This is his first time in Liangquan Town.
He also asked Lin Heqing where he was from and where he was going now.
The two were chatting casually, but Lin Heqing was a little concerned about it.
In fact, in ancient times, asking this had no other meaning, it was just a step to understand each other.
But in Lin Heqing's concept, in ancient times, as long as you knew your name and address, you could basically find someone. Revealing your information rashly could easily give others the opportunity to harm you.
Besides, Xianyang City is so big, and Fang Youwei didn’t say where he lives. Whether his name is really Fang Youwei remains to be verified.
Lin Heqing decided to just tell some facts that everyone knew. It might be embarrassing for everyone to say nothing.
"I am from Liangquan Town. I was born here. I have been in Liangquan Town since I was a child. This is my first time traveling far away.
Brother Youwei, I really envy you. You can travel all over the world and have so much knowledge. "
"Hahahaha, what's the point? When you grow up, you will also have your own career. When the time comes, the sky is high and the sea is vast, and you can go wherever you want."
In fact, Fang Youwei should be asking habitually, because he has always been a leader and is used to knowing everyone's background and identity, which makes it easier for him to get along with others better.
And he saw that Lin Heqing was carefree. A child who was traveling far away for the first time didn't need to be so defensive, so getting along with Lin Heqing became more natural.
The specific manifestation is that Fang Youwei no longer chats with Lin Heqing every day for nothing, but opens his eyes and strikes up a conversation when he gets interested.
Originally, there were only two sets of bedding on Lin Heqing's carriage, one for each person. Lin Heqing was still drawing strips, so he didn't feel crowded when sleeping on the carriage at night.
When Fang Youwei arrived at Lin Heqing's carriage, the quilt was not enough. Lin Heqing and Grandpa Qi shared the same quilt.
Two days later, when passing by a town, the escort went inside. Generally, escorts would not enter a town unless they wanted to replenish supplies.
It's the same this time. With so many people, we need to purchase a carriage and buy some dry food and quilts. The weather is getting colder and colder. If there are no quilts, it will be difficult to go on the road.
Fortunately, the caravan that was robbed said that he still had some savings hidden away and could still buy things by himself.
The strange thing is that Fang Youwei obviously had money to buy a silk quilt, but he didn't buy another carriage.
Instead, he chose to buy a silk quilt for Lin Heqing and Dr. Qi as an apology for disturbing them. You know, this quilt is not a cheap thing.
When passing the border between the two countries, the escort team stopped. Lin Heqing did not get out of the car, and when he looked outside in the car, there were sounds from everywhere.
The place leading out was a super large city gate where five carriages could walk side by side. There were officers and soldiers standing guard with red tassel guns on the side.
Lin Heqing's motorcade was caught in the middle, with the front, rear, left and right sides blocked tightly. He couldn't see anything and could only hear some sounds.
